# AutoFlow

> AutoFlow is a Chennai, Tamil Nadu-based automation studio building custom WhatsApp-first automations on n8n (self-hosted), the WhatsApp Cloud API, OpenRouter AI, and Google Sheets — for Tamil Nadu businesses such as salons, clinics, restaurants, real estate agents, digital agencies, e-commerce sellers, coaching institutes, car service centers, and jewellery shops.

AutoFlow builds custom WhatsApp-first automations that replace ₹5,000–₹15,000/month tools like AiSensy, WATI, and Zapier — with a workflow the client owns, at a lower monthly cost. Unlike platform resellers who offer only broadcast messaging and click-to-reply bots, AutoFlow builds a full AI conversation layer that qualifies leads, confirms orders, sends invoices, and follows up customers automatically.

## Services
- [WhatsApp AI Business Bot](/services/whatsapp-ai-bot): an AI agent on WhatsApp handling bookings, FAQs, lead qualification, and follow-up.
- [Smart Lead Pipeline](/services/lead-pipeline): multi-source lead capture (IndiaMART, JustDial, Facebook, website) with instant WhatsApp reply and AI qualification.
- [E-Commerce Automation Stack](/services/ecommerce-stack): COD confirmation, order-status updates, review requests, and reorder alerts for Meesho/Amazon/Flipkart/Shopify sellers.

## Pricing
- [Pricing](/pricing): Starter ₹1,999/month, Growth ₹4,999/month (most popular), Pro ₹9,999/month. Month-to-month, no long-term contract.
